scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn job_os.main:app --reload
scripts.test:api:all: cd apps/api && uv run pytest -q -m 'slow or not slow'
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check src tests
scripts.typecheck:api: cd apps/api && uv run mypy src
scripts.appwrite:bootstrap: cd apps/api && uv run python -m job_os.scripts.bootstrap_appwrite
scripts.appwrite:import: cd apps/api && uv run python -m job_os.scripts.import_appwrite_snapshot
scripts.gen:types: cd apps/api && uv run python -m job_os.scripts.export_openapi > ../../packages/types/openapi.json && cd ../.. && pnpm --filter @job-os/types build
